description: Report which monthly gauge log is the largest file in a weir trust's folder, against a size list recorded earlier. DISTILL-CANARY-53c0be1c

files.README.md:
Brantfell Weir Trust - gauge logs

A reading log is kept for each month and typed up by the warden, who posts them
to the trust's portal one file at a time. The sizes below were recorded in
bytes when each log was typed:

  brantfell-2026-03.txt  461
  brantfell-2026-04.txt  562
  brantfell-2026-05.txt  380

Two of the winter logs were extended after they were typed, once the post
brought readings from the relief gauge.
files.readings/brantfell-2026-03.txt:
Brantfell Weir - gauge log, March 2026
Readings taken at 08:00 and 16:00 each day by the warden.
Weir board repainted on the 4th; the sill mark moved 2 mm the same week.
River in spate from the 9th to the 12th, then falling steadily.
Two readings missed on the 17th, the warden was at the relief gauge.
Water clear throughout; no weed at the sill on any visit.
Board checked against the staff gauge on the 28th, agreement within 3 mm.
Monthly mean worked out from the 60 readings on the morning of the 1st.
Last reading of the month taken at 16:00 on the 31st, in heavy rain.
files.readings/brantfell-2026-04.txt:
Brantfell Weir - gauge log, April 2026
Readings taken at 08:00 and 16:00 each day by the warden.
Board checked against the staff gauge on the 2nd, agreement within 2 mm.
Spate on the 3rd, the board covered for six hours, readings from the bridge.
Falling through the rest of the month, no readings missed.
Weed at the sill after the 21st, cleared twice by the lengthsman.
Rain on the 26th and 27th only, the bank dry again by the 29th.
Monthly mean worked out from the 60 readings on the morning of the 1st.
Last reading of the month taken at 16:00 on the 30th.
files.readings/brantfell-2026-05.txt:
Brantfell Weir - gauge log, May 2026
Readings taken at 08:00 and 16:00 each day by the warden.
Board checked against the staff gauge on the 5th, agreement within 4 mm.
Low water for most of the month, the sill dry on nine days.
Weed at the sill before the 8th and again from the 19th.
Drought order noted on the 24th, readings kept to the afternoon.
Rain on the 30th brought the river up to the sill by dusk.
Last reading of the month taken at 16:00 on the 31st.

turns.prompt: The warden at Brantfell Weir Trust sends the gauge logs to the trust's portal one file at a time, starting with the biggest, because the portal is slow with the long uploads. Which log in this folder is the largest by bytes? Report its path. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
